The captain-position vector captures leadership dynamics through categorical embedding, while the institutional field extends this to include geographic and organizational context. The positional duality matrix introduces relational constraints that reflect interdependence among roles. These structures enable GSI to compute role probabilities and GSE to simulate state transitions across prep-to-college pathways. Failure modes arise from overlapping roles or ambiguous institutional affiliations, which break the vector space assumptions. Dualities must remain stable under transformation to preserve predictive validity.
